title: I thought I found a real life bathroom maze.
content: Last night's dream included the bathroom maze..I really had to go and I walked into the first bathroom I could find to see rows of toilets in shared stalls or toilets with no walls. In the dream I remember saying "wow this is actually my worst nightmare" and thinking how funny it was to find a bathroom like the ones in my dreams. I did not realize I was currently in a dream even though it should've been obvious. I've had mallworld dreams for years and have never been lucid.
